newsitem.title: USA: United Industrial unit awarded Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: United Industrial unit awarded Navy contract.

text.p: A unit of United Industrial Corp, Engineering and Maintenance Services, said it received a $7.6 million contract from the U.S. Navy to move propulsion test equipment from the Naval Air Warfare Center in Trenton, N.J., to Patuxent River, Maryland.
The move is part of the Navy's Base Realignment and Closure Act.
The contract is to be completed over the next two and a half years.

Engineering and Maintenance Services is a wholly owned subsidiary of AAI Corp which is a subsidiary of United Industrial. Engineering and Maintenance markets on-site logistical support for government-owned equipment.
